title: A comprehensive evaluation of self-attention for detecting regulatory feature interactions.
one_liner_zh: 该文评估并改进自注意力模型用于检测转录因子结合协同性，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作中的调控特征，方法为AI深度学习，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The successful use of deep learning in computational biology depends on the ability to extract meaningful biological information from the trained models. Recent work has demonstrated that the attention maps generated by self-attention layers can be interpreted to predict cooperativity between binding of transcription factors, a key feature of gene regulatory networks. We extend this earlier work and demonstrate that the addition of an entropy term yields high-precision sparse attention maps that are easy to interpret. Furthermore, we performed a comprehensive evaluation of the relative performance of different flavors of attention-based transcription factor cooperativity discovery. Our findings demonstrate the benefit of the entropy-enhanced attention models and provide additional insights that would enable practitioners to make effective use of this valuable tool for biological discovery.
abstract_zh: 深度学习在计算生物学中的成功应用，依赖于从训练模型中提取有意义的生物学信息的能力。近期研究表明，自注意力层生成的注意力图可被解释以预测转录因子结合之间的协同性，这是基因调控网络的一个关键特征。我们扩展了先前的工作，并证明加入熵项能够产生高精度、稀疏且易于解释的注意力图。此外，我们对不同形式的基于注意力的转录因子协同性发现方法的相对性能进行了全面评估。我们的发现展示了熵增强注意力模型的优势，并提供了额外见解，使实践者能够有效利用这一有价值的工具进行生物学发现。
